description: Ash Harbor WM/WSK 输出格式规则配置。修改格式时更新此文件，不需改脚本。

[移动].format_desc: [移动] {原地点所在子区域} -> {中间子区域 Route} -> {目标地点所在子区域} | Steps: {N} | Travel Time: {N}min（链上每个节点固定 Zone/Sub-zone 两层一斜杠，禁止 Location 三层写法；1 step 时链上仅首尾两个节点）或 [移动] 无

[掷骰].format_pattern: ^\[掷骰\] (Trigger: (hostile-contact|npc-contact|获得|third-party-sighting|trade-complication|world-event|wear-weather|wear-sabotage|wear-usage|custom)(#\d+)?: [^；*#_]+；Base: \d+(（[^；）*#_]*）)?；Modifiers: (?![^；]*(?<![0-9])[+-]0(?![0-9]))[^；*#_]+；Final: \d+；Seed: \d+；Threshold: \d+；Result: (触发|未触发)；Outcome: [^；*#_]+|Dase-\d+(；Dase-\d+)*|wear-(weather|sabotage|usage): 未触发(；wear-(weather|sabotage|usage): 未触发)*|无概率事件)$
[掷骰].format_desc: [掷骰] Trigger: {类名}: {...}；Base: {N}（理由可省）；Modifiers: {...}；Final/Seed/Threshold: {N}；Result: {触发/未触发}；Outcome: {...} 或 Dase-N / wear-*: 未触发 / 无概率事件

[判定].format_desc: [判定] 消耗（D{prev}->D{curr}）: {物品×数量}；{类别}: {结果}（如 获得: {...}）或 [判定] 无

[主要状态].format_desc: [主要状态] D{Day}-T{Turn} {HH:MM} | {位置} | {Season}-{天气}-{气温} | {压力} | {风险}
